column1: # F4): the (method row, renderer row) pairs `MFTRACE FDROUTE ... row=ROW
# ren=REN` may print. The text a FIND site gets is keyed by (frame row,
# method row, renderer row); the method row is T-FIND's (finder.c `fd_rows[]`),
# the renderer row is the asker's own (docs/trace_format.md "FDROUTE"):
#   E-find    window.c Table B (`wf_brows`): B-fn, B-pair, B-memchr, B-walk, B-hors
#   composer  compose.c `fd_renderers`: the arm that renders the pick
# HAND-MAINTAINED, and written from the two renderer tables, not from the
# trace. A row added to either table adds its pair(s) here in the same commit.
# Reader: tests/memfn/rows_check.py section R: (1) every FDROUTE pair any
# traced compile of the run prints is a line here; (2) a line with a witness
# is printed by its witness (a pcrec compile of `pattern` under `flags`,
# after `-p rx --features all`); a line with no witness (`-`) prints
#   flags    pcrec flags for the witness compile (space-separated)
